as_told.title: Harrington's months-long briefing: the aliens were 'like day three'

plain: John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, said he was briefed for months in an underground facility in West Virginia, and that seeing the aliens came only around day three. The Hollywood writer Brent Friedman tells it, repeating what he says Herrington told him, including the line: "No, Brent, you don't understand. That was like day three." If true, a cabinet member would have been shown far more than the public knows.
